name: Veg hakka
ingredients_raw: Noodles: Wheat Flour, Refined Palm Oil, Salt, Potassium Chloride (Gelling Agent, E508), Wheat Gluten, Sodium Polyphosphates (Emulsifying Agent, E452(i)), Potassium Carbonate (Acidity Regulator, E501(i)), Sodium Hydrogen Carbonate (Raising Agent, E500(ii)), Tertiary Butylhydroquinone (Antioxidant, E319). Seasoning Mix: Garlic Powder (27%), Salt, Mixed Spices 11% (chilli, ginger, onion, pepper, turmeric), Dehydrated Garlic Bits (11%), Tomato Powder, Corn Flour, Sugar, Disodium 5'-Guanylate, Disodium 5'-Inosinate (Flavour Enhancers, E627, E631), Dehydrated Vegetables 2% (carrot, parsley), Soy Sauce Powder (soybean, wheat, salt), Silicon Dioxide (Anticaking Agent, E551), Citric Acid (Acidifying Agent, E330), Sunflower Oil.
